answer: In the horn worker's shop the combs are cut from horn warmed over the fire, and every tooth must be sawn true or the comb snags. Proof of horn worker comb via tooth cut tally is the cutting: a comb the worker cuts only after 24 teeth are sawn true, each tooth tried on the horn. The dawn is the first tooth, sawn when the horn was warm; the violet is the last, sawn when the comb was polished. A cheat must saw 29 false teeth and warm 29 false horns, and the mirror still combs no hair.
